BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   D. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

8. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   C. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

13. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   B. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   C. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   C. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

16. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
